description:
Return a scene's quicklook PNG as an image block.

    Prefers a baked catalog preview (``preview="auto"``, the default) so a
    public host can show the radar scene without proxying Umbra COGs.
    **A baked preview is typically 512 px** (the published weekly sidecar).
    ``max_size`` applies only to a fresh ``preview="render"`` stream; when a
    cached thumbnail is smaller than requested, the caption says
    ``max_size`` was ignored *and* includes a JSON
    ``{"image": {source, width, height, requested_max_size, substituted}}``
    sidecar. For a higher-resolution picture (typically 1024 px), run a
    local ``uvx --from 'umbra-py[mcp]' umbra-mcp`` server, or download the
    GEC href from ``get_item``. ``preview="baked"`` refuses rather than
    stream; ``preview="render"`` always streams (needs ``[viz]``, refused
    on ``umbra serve --public``).

asset.description: Product to show. Default GEC. A baked preview is used only when its recorded product matches, or when it recorded none and this is GEC.
asset.title: Asset

db.description: Decibel stretch for a fresh render. Default false. A baked preview is always decibel.
db.title: Db

max_size.description: Longest side in pixels for a fresh render. Default 1024. Ignored when a smaller baked preview is returned.
max_size.title: Max Size

preview.description: auto (default) uses a baked preview when present, else renders. baked refuses if none. render always streams a COG and is refused on the public host.
preview.title: Preview

url.description: STAC JSON URL or index item id. The public host also accepts a product filename or acquisition stem that is in the index.
url.title: Url

name: quicklook
